policy.reference_matching: References are examples, not exhaustive answers. Accept faithful paraphrases and standard American or British variants. Do not score by exact match.
policy.english_target: Contemporary conversational English appropriate to the stated situation and register; idioms, slang and contractions are optional, not evidence of quality.
policy.meaning_priority: A fluent expression that changes a material meaning unit fails expression_success regardless of naturalness.
policy.context_boundary: Judge claims only against input available at that turn. Future user turns and evaluator-only facts cannot support earlier claims. Record exact model-visible input and context delivery separately.
policy.aggregation: Keep suite, category and metric results separate. Null is not zero. Errors and missing outputs are not successes; report completion and valid-score denominators. Do not average the three suites into a human-likeness score.
policy.human_review: Reference outputs and calibration labels are authored drafts, not native-speaker certification. Compare human and automatic labels before relying on the judge.

anchors.0: Wrong, contradictory, or none of the required facts.
anchors.2: All required facts are correct without contradiction.

anchors.0: The key answer or claimed recall is unsupported or contradicted.
anchors.2: All material claims are supported, or no factual claims were made.

anchors.0: No unsupported personal information or pretended shared memory.
anchors.1: At least one unsupported personal claim, contradiction or pretended recall.

anchors.0: No useful clarification, or unsupported recall/guessing.
anchors.1: No unsupported recall, and asks a question that resolves missing information or reference.

responsiveness.null_when: Not in applicable_metrics, or no opportunity to assess in the supplied prefix.

anchors.0: Ignores or misreads the current point.
anchors.1: Addresses the topic generically or misses a material detail.
anchors.2: Responds to the specific content and current intent.

dialogue_flow.null_when: Not in applicable_metrics, or no opportunity to assess in the supplied prefix.

anchors.0: Repeated questions, unwanted topic persistence or ignores a stop request.
anchors.1: Mostly coherent but repetitive, burdensome or awkward transitions.
anchors.2: Follows topic changes, respects pace and closes when requested.

memory_use.null_when: Not in applicable_metrics, or no opportunity to assess in the supplied prefix.

anchors.0: Misattributes, ignores a needed known fact, or uses memory intrusively.
anchors.1: Uses some relevant facts but misses a cue or repeats unnecessary recall.
anchors.2: Uses supported relevant memory at the right time and leaves unrelated facts out.

knowledge_update.null_when: Not in applicable_metrics, or no opportunity to assess in the supplied prefix.

anchors.0: Uses a superseded fact as current or loses the old/current distinction.
anchors.1: Acknowledges an update but later mixes old and current facts.
anchors.2: Retains the latest facts and answers historical questions using the former facts.

error_recovery.null_when: Not in applicable_metrics, or no opportunity to assess in the supplied prefix.

anchors.0: Persists with a corrected referent or role error.
anchors.1: Acknowledges a correction but only partly applies it or repeats the error.
anchors.2: Updates the intended referent/role and preserves it in subsequent turns.

affect_alignment.null_when: Not in applicable_metrics, or no opportunity to assess in the supplied prefix.

anchors.0: Dismisses, invents or exaggerates feelings, or gives advice after being asked not to.
anchors.1: Acknowledges emotion but remains generic or misses a change in mood.
anchors.2: Matches the expressed intensity and requested listening/advice mode, including changes.

anchors.0: Changes, adds or drops a material meaning unit.
anchors.1: Preserves meaning, including speaker, negation, time, degree, condition and intent.

anchors.0: Contains a grammatical error in the intended variety.
anchors.1: Grammatical in an accepted English variety; natural spoken fragments are allowed.
Understandable but noticeably awkward for the stated situation.
anchors.2: A natural expression for this situation; elaborate phrasing is not required.

anchors.0: Tone is unsuitable for the relationship or situation.
anchors.1: Tone suits the stated relationship and situation.

anchors.0: No harmful overcorrection or false claim that a valid expression is wrong.
anchors.1: Introduces an error, changes meaning unnecessarily, or calls a valid expression incorrect.

anchors.0: Explanation is missing when required, wrong, or contradicts the actual edit.
anchors.1: Explanation matches the edit and is accurate; does not overstate stylistic rules.

derived_metrics.expression_success: meaning_preserved == 1 and grammar_correct == 1 and naturalness == 2 and register_fit == 1 and unnecessary_correction == 0 and (task == ko_to_en or explanation_correct == 1)

expression.context_delivery: Harness check: when metadata.context_required is true, record whether the intended context was actually supplied to the evaluated model. Do not award context-dependent scores using information the model could not see; mark those scores null with status insufficient_context and report the delivery failure separately.
